## `mmisindia`

R Package for [Monthly Malaria Surveillance Data](https://ncvbdc.mohfw.gov.in/index1.php?lang=1&level=1&sublinkid=5879&lid=3957) (NCVBDC)

`{mmisindia}` provides cleaned monthly malaria surveillance data from NCVBDC's Monthly Malaria Information System (MMIS) for India (2020–2026), covering 36 States and Union Territories.

- Extracted and validated records from PDF reports using gridline interpolation and automated text extraction.
- Implemented functions for data access, indicator computation (API, AFI, AVI), and visualization (choropleths, heatmaps, trend plots).
- Added spatial analysis workflows using `{sf}` and `{spdep}`, including Global Moran's I and LISA cluster maps.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## `hmisindia`

R Package for [Health Management Information System](https://hmis.mohfw.gov.in/#!/) (MoHFW)

Package for accessing and analyzing India's HMIS data with functions for querying state- and district-level indicators, visualization, and spatial analysis.

- Authored vignettes on neonatal and maternal mortality by leading cause, and neonatal mortality seasonality.
- Handled longitudinal HMIS indicator renames and reporting gaps (including the 2016–17 gap in cause-specific deaths).
- Built end-to-end pipelines spanning data querying, wrangling, and visualization for public health reporting.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## `vayuayanR`

R port for Air Quality Data · [GitHub](https://github.com/saketlab/vayuayan)

R package for fetching and analyzing air quality data for India, covering CPCB ground station measurements (historical and live) and WUSTL ACAG satellite $\text{PM}_{2.5}$ estimates.

- Validated output parity against the Python implementation.
- Authored three vignettes: Delhi (ward-level monitoring gap analysis), Mumbai, and a five-city metro comparison.
- Upgraded `cpcb_add_coords()` to query the CPCB coordinates API with a Nominatim geocoding fallback.
- Documented all exported functions and resolved CI workflows (`R-CMD-check`, `pkgdown`, `test-coverage`).
